children: Keros Therapeutics has launched a $5 million share repurchase program following the receipt of a $20 million development milestone payment under a license agreement with Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA.

The payment under the elritercept license agreement came after the dosing of the first patient in the ELRiSE MDS clinical trial which is investigating a treatment for anemia. Keros in July said that it would receive the development milestone payment.

The board of Keros, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, approved the share repurchase program, which allows management to buy outstanding shares, from time to time, in the open market or by other means that abide by state and federal securities laws.
